title: What is the normal range for heart rate?

messages.content: What is the normal range for heart rate?

According to the American Heart Association (AHA), a normal heart rate for adults is typically between 60-100 beats per minute (bpm) at rest. (Source: American Heart Association, "Heart Rate and Blood Pressure Measurement")

For pt-1, I would like to know their age and any relevant medical history to provide a more accurate assessment of their heart rate.

Please provide the following information:

- Age
- Medical history (if any)
- Current heart rate measurement (if available)
